user.title: Connect to the LifeMiles watcher
user.description: Enter the address of the machine running the watcher app (it serves the status at http://HOST:PORT/status.json).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the watcher at that address.
error.invalid_response: That address answered, but it is not a LifeMiles watcher.
error.invalid_host: Enter only the host name or IP address, without http:// or a path.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This watcher is already set up.
